verdict.rationale: Supabase auto-generates REST and GraphQL APIs from the database schema and a live probe confirms a real spec-compliant OpenAPI document at supabase.com/openapi.json, giving AI agents a documented machine-readable API surface. This is reinforced by CLI and MCP tooling that lets an agent programmatically provision and query projects headlessly. Missing for 10: independent third-party validation of API completeness/stability, and explicit versioning/rate-limit docs for programmatic API consumers.
